test_title: PYST 19: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: If it was Tuesday on 21 February 2017, then what will be the day of the week on 5 February 2025 ? (2020 and 2024 are leap years.)
solution:
Given : 21 February 2017 was Tuesday

Explanation :

The number of odd days from 21 February 2017 to 5 February 2025 :

 
 

 Year
 Period
 Calculation
 Odd days
 
 

 2017
 21 February 2017 - 31 December 2017
 365 days - 52 days = 313 days
 313 ÷ 7 = 5
 
 

 2018 - 2024
 Full year (5 Ordinary years + 2 Leap years)
 (1 × 5) + (2 × 2) = 9
 9 ÷ 7 = 2
 
 

 2025
 1st January 2025 - 5th February 2025
 31 day + 5 days = 36 days
 36 ÷ 7 = 1</td&
